done.ready: The offer is ready to download and send.
done.sent: The offer is marked as sent.
done.revised: A new version was made. Change its price on the pricing screen.
done.approved: The discount is approved. The offer is ready to download.
done.discountRejected: The discount is rejected. The offer is back to draft at the discount cap.

sent.title: Mark {{reference}} as sent
sent.message: Email the PDF to the company yourself, then record the date you sent it. The offer's validity starts from that date.

accepted.title: Mark {{reference}} accepted
accepted.message: Record that the company accepted this offer. Winning the deal is a separate step.

rejected.title: Mark {{reference}} rejected
rejected.message: Record that the company turned this offer down. You can add why.

revise.title: Revise {{reference}}
revise.message: This makes version {{version}} of {{number}} as a draft. The version already sent stays as it is and can still be downloaded.

approval.waiting: Waiting for approval of a {{percent}}% discount. The final download and sending are disabled until it is decided.
approval.approveMessage: The offer becomes ready to download at the approved percent. You may approve a lower percent than requested.
approval.approveInvalid: Enter a percent up to the requested {{requested}}.
approval.rejectMessage: The offer returns to draft with the discount set back to the cap. The comment is shown to the salesperson.
approval.commentRequired: A comment is required to reject.
approval.withdrawMessage: The offer returns to draft. It leaves the approver's list.
approval.requestedToast: The approval is requested. The manager is notified.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.OFFER_NOT_READY: This offer cannot be made ready yet.

notReady.NO_PRICE: An offer without a price cannot be made ready.
notReady.DISCOUNT_ABOVE_CAP: The discount is above the maximum. It needs approval first.

errors.OFFER_INVALID_TRANSITION: The offer's status has changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.OFFER_NOT_LATEST: A later version replaces this offer. Use the latest version.
errors.OFFER_NOT_EDITABLE: This offer can no longer be changed.
errors.OFFER_REVISE_FIRST: This offer has been sent. Revise it to make a new version.
errors.INVALID_SENT_DATE: Choose a date sent that is not in the future and not before the offer was made.
errors.SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.DISCOUNT_APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND: This approval request was not found.
errors.DISCOUNT_APPROVAL_TRANSITION: This request can no longer be decided. Reload the page and try again.

approvalsList.title: Discount approvals
approvalsList.loadFailed: The approval requests could not be loaded.
approvalsList.emptyMessage: Discounts above the cap appear here for approval.

list.title: Offers
list.loadFailed: The offers could not be loaded.
list.emptyMessage: Offers are made from a deal's pricing screen.
